He was talking about what was I going to add to the world. What value I would bring, what joy and satisfaction I would derive from making those contributions. I had no idea. He said I should start writing a life plan and focus on several key areas of my life. I thought I could knock that out in a couple of days. It took me two years. BUT I kept at it. I tried over and over again to write something I felt I could live up to, that would make me happy, would provide value to society, etc. I just could not figure this out. I did not know who I was or what I wanted. So I quit trying and instead, started looking at things that made me happy. In that process, I figured out things do not bring happiness, you need to find joy inside first and that is something I finally figured out. How to have joy without having circumstances perfect around me. Once that happened, the ideas started flowing and in a moment of inspiration, my life plan came to me. I wrote it in a few minutes, fleshed it out over the next few days and I ended up with a document that has guided my life ever since.
